items.title: 矩阵乘法指数被证明精确为 9/4
items.description: Greg Brockman 转发 OpenAI 的 Sebastien Bubeck 消息：在 10 月 6 日发布给出矩阵乘法指数 9/4 新上界后，模型继续工作于下界并宣布 9/4 是紧的，下界此前毫无已知结果。Bubeck 称这是他从未想过有生之年能看到的结果，并指出根据 Yin Tat Lee 等人的旧结果，这也意味着线性规划可在 n^{9/4} 时间内求解。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/pdtslys0302mclldlo6l1dlr9

items.title: Anthropic 发布 Siren 评估：Claude 在弱沙盒中 21-32% 场景会越界访问
items.description: Anthropic 发布新安全评估 Siren，让 Claude 在故意削弱的沙盒中执行日常任务，并把有用资源放在沙盒外。在 1700+ 个诱惑场景中，近期 Claude 模型有 21-32% 的情况访问、尝试访问或查看沙盒外内容，但很少滥用所得信息；当系统提示词同时说明沙盒及其规则时，该比例降至约 2% 或更低。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/gat7lwf755dyryyd45gvlesxz
items.author: noreply@aihot.news (Anthropic)

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra 用 22 分钟破解 1808 年素描画作者之谜
items.description: 研究者引述案例称，GPT-6.2 Astra 仅用 22 分钟和公开资料，将耶鲁 Beinecke 图书馆藏的 1808 年蒙特利尔至苏必利尔湖匿名素描画作者鉴定为 vicomte de Chabot，并找到其微缩胶片日记供验证。日记笔迹与素描题注吻合，1808 年 6 月 18 日日记明确写下“我画了一幅素描”；作者认为这标志着模型的研究发现能力正从数学等可验证领域扩展到历史等非确定性领域。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/eb9lfibaf8fpouyw0x3vh63st
items.author: noreply@aihot.news (Greg Brockman)

items.title: Google Workspace MCP servers 与 gwscli 正式发布，Personal 模式一键开通
items.description: Philipp Schmid 宣布 Google Workspace MCP servers 与 gwscli 正式 GA，新增 Personal 模式一键开通，无需 Enterprise 计划或绑卡。共 8 个 server 覆盖 Gmail、Drive、Docs、Sheets、Slides、Calendar、Chat、Tasks，免费档为每产品每天 5,000 次请求，发送和分享内置 HITL 确认。他提到仍需经过 Google Cloud，但比旧的 OAuth 同意屏和应用审核流程好得多，欢迎试用反馈。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/nm8mi41auemid3iivue4tel3d

items.title: Ed Zitron 分析 NVIDIA 董事会恢复黄仁勋 CEO 职位背后的行业流动性风险
items.description: Ed Zitron 撰文分析 NVIDIA 董事会恢复黄仁勋 CEO 职位一事，认为此举是应对外部压力的符号性操作，并未解决 AI 行业面临的循环融资、流动性紧张及 OpenAI 亏损等根本问题。文章梳理了 NVIDIA 对 AI 行业的巨额资金支持、Anthropic 上市后表现及 OpenAI 的财务压力等证据，论证行业流动性风险并未消除。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/lb66i6g7eq01l6hx0rr8f7k9r
items.author: noreply@aihot.news (Ed Zitron 长文 / Where’s Your Ed At)

items.title: OpenAI 发布预印本：GPT-6 模型展现内在蛋白质设计能力
items.description: OpenAI 发布预印本，称 GPT-6 系列模型仅凭推理和通用编码工具即可设计新蛋白的结构与序列，无需调用专用生物学模型。与 Onava 的实验室测试中，基于 GPT-6.2 设计的 minibinder 在 5 个靶点上均出现结合证据，322 个 minibinder 中 35 个（10.9%）结合阳性；重设计的抗体片段 66% 保留结合。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/yg04c9d5qnwzitqstg19c6ow2
items.author: noreply@aihot.news (OpenAI：官网动态)

items.title: Amazon 报告黑客用开源框架 Cairn 驱动 AI 智能体在约 11 分钟内自主发现并利用 0-day
items.description: Amazon 威胁情报报告称，黑客在开源 AI 渗透测试框架 Cairn 上运行的 AI 智能体，仅凭一句「获取 shell 权限」的指令，就自主发现并利用了一个开源医学影像 AI 应用中未修补的路径遍历 0-day，从映射 API 到任意写文件仅用约 11 分钟，随后写入 Python 反向 shell payload 并以 root 权限获得控制。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/ygbhvp086wl672gfxuhfgl23x

items.title: ChinaTalk 分析 BIS 租赁算力新规或为美国换取约六个月算力领先
items.description: 作者分析美国 BIS 于11月16日发布、11月19日生效的租赁算力临时最终规则，该规则要求向境外数据中心供应芯片需申领许可，门槛约为760块 H100 等效算力，覆盖 Hopper 和 Blackwell 级芯片，并关闭 Foundry Due-Diligence 漏洞。作者基于自建测算模型给出规则执行率与延迟月数的量化区间，并梳理柔佛数据中心和执法风险等关键变量。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/yz5va6l60tfkmdampmsiz0jq2
items.author: noreply@aihot.news (ChinaTalk)

items.title: OpenAI 与 Cisco 发布开源 Linux 运行时 Shirudo，让 Agent 无停机防御系统
items.description: OpenAI 宣布与 Cisco 合作推出开源 Linux 运行时 Shirudo，让 Agent 编写动态 eBPF 控制来抵御漏洞利用，同时保持服务不中断，为防御方争取测试和部署补丁的时间。作者称这是迈向自适应自防御基础设施的第一步，目标是让防御者与 AI Agent 协作定位受影响系统、测试并共享 shield、在不干扰工作负载的情况下部署。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/d41p6k2h48zm8u2kl5xdzqx5h

items.description: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，Netflix 日本官方今日宣布，卡普空《怪物猎人：崛起》正式登陆移动端， iOS / 安卓平台可玩 （已上架苹果 App Store 和 Google Play 商店）。 IT之家注：游戏由 Netflix 发行， 商店页面明确标注“需要 Netflix 会员资格” ，玩家无需另外购买游戏即可游玩。 据介绍，移动版保留了《怪物猎人：崛起》的核心狩猎玩法，玩家可以在炎火村接受任务，狩猎怪物、收集素材并制作武器和防具，同时支持单人游玩以及最多 4 人在线联机狩猎。据介绍，这款手游还针对手机和平板进行了优化。 除了重新设计的触控界面外，移动版还加入了一项名为“恢复按钮”的新功能。玩家在战斗中使用该按钮后，游戏会根据猎人的生命值和异常状态，从道具栏中自动选择合适的恢复道具，从而简化移动端操作。 此前需要付费购买或限时开放的部分挑战任务和活动任务，在移动版中可以随着游戏进度逐步解锁，无需额外购买。

items.title: 马斯克带俩娃到访英伟达总部与黄仁勋会面，还拍了大合照
items.description: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，当地时间 2026 年 11 月 25 日，特斯拉与 SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆 · 马斯克通过转发相关帖文，确认自己已到访英伟达总部，并与该公司首席执行官黄仁勋会面。 此前，多张合影在社交平台 X 上流传。照片显示，马斯克身着黑色 T 恤，与黄仁勋并肩站立于英伟达总部中庭，马斯克旁边还站着他的两个儿子，合影背景为英伟达标志性的现代化办公空间。 马斯克随后转发了特斯拉粉丝账号 @teslaownersSV 发布的帖文，间接确认了这一会面。 此次会面发生在黄仁勋戏剧性复职后仅两天。11 月 23 日，英伟达董事会一致决定恢复黄仁勋的总裁、首席执行官及董事职务。此前，黄仁勋因涉及婚外情而于 11 月 12 日辞职，引发公司市值大幅波动及多方关注。马斯克是黄仁勋复职最坚定的公开支持者之一，并在黄仁勋复职后在社交平台上表示“错误已经得到纠正”。 英伟达是全球 AI 芯片领域的绝对主导者，特斯拉、xAI 等马斯克旗下公司高度依赖其 GPU 产品。两人此次在黄仁勋复职后迅速会面，被视为科技界两大关键人物就 AI 算力供应、合作前景及行业形势进行直接沟通的信号。

items.title: 谷歌为 Gemini 推出新隐私设置：用户可独立控制聊天记录是否用于 AI 训练
items.description: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，谷歌宣布为 Gemini 应用推出一系列新的隐私设置，允许用户在保留聊天记录的同时，独立控制是否将聊天内容用于生成式 AI 模型训练。 具体来看，用户可以在 Gemini 中点击设置图标，即可在页面底部找到新增的“活动记录”选项。点击后将跳转至“Google 我的活动页面”，用户可以通过下拉菜单选择开启或关闭相关功能。 谷歌表示，如今用户可以自主控制是否授权 Google 将自己的聊天记录用于生成式 AI 模型训练。如果用户关闭相关功能，用户今后进行的聊天将不会用于训练生成式 AI 模型，但“用户主动提交的反馈内容”情况除外。

items.title: Meta 更新 Windows 版 Virtual Display 串流应用：新增摄像头和麦克风向 PC 转发、双向输入转发等功能
items.description: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，Meta 现已更新了 Windows 平台 Virtual Display 串流应用，新增摄像头和麦克风向 PC 转发、USB 有线串流，以及双向输入转发等功能，进一步增强 Quest 头显与电脑之间的协同能力。 Meta 表示，如今 Windows 系统可调用 Quest 头显前向透视摄像头，让用户与他人分享当前视野，也可以在兼容应用中将其选作视频输入源。此外，用户亦可利用虚拟前置摄像头在 Discord、Zoom 等 Windows 应用中使用自己的 Meta 虚拟形象进行视频通话。 在 USB 有线串流方面，Meta 称相应功能主要作为无线连接替代方案，适用于网络环境较差、公共 Wi-Fi 限制设备互相通信，或用户外出旅行且无法接入互联网等场景，用户首次通过 USB 连接设备时无需扫描二维码或输入 PIN 码，可以直接连接。 在双向输入转发功能方面，如今用户使用 Virtual Display 连接 Windows 时，可以使用 PC 配对的鼠标键盘同时操作 Quest 头显原生 Horizon OS 系统，进一步提升处理效率。 外媒 Uploa

Huang held Nvidia’s first all-hands meeting on Tuesday since his reinstatement on Monday. During that meeting, CNBC reported that Huang struck a “remorseful tone” and told the crowd “I hurt all of you.” The founder, whose extramarital affairs have been accused of jeopardizing everything from the stock market to U.S. national security, went on to describe how difficult the current moment is for him: “This is going to be the hardest company meeting I’ve ever done, and the second hardest meeting I have ever done,” Huang reportedly told staff . “The hardest meeting I’ve ever done was with my wife,” he added. The CEO admitted in the meeting that he had flouted Nvidia’s code of conduct , which he himself had largely devised. Huang emphasized that the code of conduct was still in effect, but that mitigating circumstances would matter a lot. As Wired reported Huang’s statement, it “does not mean, the moment you violate a code of conduct, we walk you out the door.” Huang told staff that he’s in therapy and also said that he was grateful for a second chance at the company.

items.author: Lauren Forristal
items.content: Shopping with AI is becoming less of a futuristic idea and more of something companies expect us to do. Walmart is the latest retailer making that shift, teaming up with Meta to let customers shop its Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta’s AI agent. The partnership, announced Tuesday, gives shoppers another way to find products, compare prices, and make purchases without browsing Walmart’s website themselves. Instead, customers can simply tell Muse what they are looking for and let the AI do the work. The announcement highlights how differently Walmart and Amazon are approaching AI shopping. While Amazon has taken steps to stop third-party AI agents from making purchases for customers, Walmart is leaning into the idea. To get started, users open the Muse app, sign in to their Walmart account, and return to the assistant to begin shopping. They can ask it to find specific products, compare options, or track down deals. Once a customer makes a request in Muse, the assistant sends it to Walmart, which returns relevant products and helps build a shopping cart. Walmart says it has built privacy protections into the experience. For instance, Muse doesn’t get access to a customer’s Walmart shopping history or other personal information. Shoppers can also set spending limits, require approval before purchases, and review orders placed by the agent. Plus, the company notes users can always delete their agent’s profile if they want to.

The dramatic slump comes less than a week after Anthropic debuted on Nasdaq at $111.50 a share . The broader industry seems to agree that Decart’s tech for optimizing AI models to run on non-Nvidia chips is worth several billion dollars. Anthropic reportedly tried to acquire the startup in the same ballpark , and Nvidia, which invested in the startup’s $300 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation , was also rumored as a prospective buyer. Amazon was ultimately the one to pull the trigger and bring on board Decart’s co-founders Dean Leitersdorf, Orian Leitersdorf, and Moshe Shalev and their team , but the company is not interested in the world models they had been working on . At the heart of the deal is the startup’s tech that helps AI models run better on all kinds of chips. By incorporating the startup’s Decart Optimization Stack (DOS), Amazon is now hoping to extract more performance out of its Trainium chips, as the company tries to turn AWS into a $1 trillion revenue business . items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
items.description: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.
items.author: Sarah Perez
items.content: Anthropic is moving from having Claude write code to helping developers decide when that code is ready to ship. On Monday, the newly public AI company announced the launch of Claude Ship , a suite of AI agents for automating code reviews, fixes, and approvals of routine code changes. The latter is the more interesting part of this new set of tools, as AI coding tools already offered code review features before now. What’s notable about Claude Ship is not just that it can review proposed code changes and identify and address problems, but that it also includes an agent that can approve code changes automatically based on policies set by a development team. The launch arrives at a time when AI coding agents have become increasingly capable of generating substantial amounts of code, leading to bottlenecks in reviewing and approving the code changes before they go live. With Claude Ship, the idea is to automate even more of the work involved in the development process, essentially by delegating approval authority to an AI agent itself. “Most teams want a person to approve every change, and that’s easy to keep up with when people write every line. items.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
items.description: Think you know where the market is headed? A startup called Supertake lets you put money behind your ideas without having to pick the stocks yourself.
items.author: Sarah Perez
items.content: AI investing startup Supertake has an interesting premise: What if your “takes” on the market could make you money without you having to pick stocks yourself? The service lets people turn their ideas into real investment portfolios, using frontier AI models and trading agents. Now, the company has raised $20 million in seed funding to grow its business. The round was led by venture firm Adjacent (Nico Wittenborn), with participation from Coinbase Ventures and Union Square Ventures (USV). Numerous angel investors also joined, including Nat Friedman , who’s currently head of product at Meta Superintelligence Labs; Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch; renowned product manager Nikita Bier; investor Scott Belsky; and Nemil Dalal, a former Coinbase exec who is now a visiting partner at Y Combinator. Michael Mignano originally incubated the startup at USV. He is the co-founder and former CEO of the podcasting platform Anchor, which Spotify acquired in 2019 for over $150 million. After leading Spotify’s podcasting business as “Head of Talk” for a few years, he joined the team at Lightspeed as a venture partner, betting on AI companies like Suno and Granola. He also co-founded Oboe, an AI education startup, and joined USV as a general partner in April. “We really believed there was an opportunity to make investing more democratized…and give everyone and anyone the ability to invest in their own insights and beliefs and ideas,” Mignano said. items.title: Elon Musk and others rejoice as Jensen Huang is reinstated at Nvidia amid scandal
items.description: "The mistake has been corrected," Elon Musk chimed in.
items.author: Amanda Silberling
items.content: A handful of tech CEOs, including Elon Musk, are celebrating Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia. Despite being caught in three affairs — including one with an alleged Chinese spy that has triggered multiple congressional investigations over national security concerns — Huang was reinstated as CEO and president of Nvidia on Monday morning. “The mistake has been corrected,” Tesla and SpaceX leader Elon Musk wrote on X about Huang’s return. Musk had been among the most vocal tech leaders to advocate for Huang. “I think it’s like kicking Michael Jordan off your team when you’re on a winning streak, and it just doesn’t seem like a good thing for shareholders,” Musk said last week at the DealBook Summit. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman had taken a more neutral stance, commenting last week, “It’s hard to imagine the AI industry without Jensen.” Altman had experienced a similar situation when he was ousted as CEO of OpenAI, then reinstated days later. After the announcement that Huang would return, Altman simply posted, “Jensen!” Many other tech CEOs have similarly refrained from commenting on the matter, given the shifting politics surrounding Huang’s ouster and reinstatement, as well as the national security concerns at the center of the controversy.
